id: 562-第一次「星際大戰」（第二次蒂卡爾-卡拉科爾戰爭）
theater: 危地馬拉佩滕盆地蒂卡爾

battle.name: 第一次「星際大戰」（第二次蒂卡爾-卡拉科爾戰爭）
battle.theater: 危地馬拉佩滕盆地蒂卡爾
battle.brief: 公元562年四月，危地馬拉佩滕盆地的蒂卡爾在卡拉科爾與卡拉克穆爾聯軍面前遭決定性敗北，國王被擒獻祭，霸權被打斷，碑銘與營建中斷近百年。瑪雅步兵的長矛以削尖燧石或蛋白石矛頭綁於木杆，與卡面所示的早王朝埃及青銅矛同屬長桿突刺矛一類，正是列陣、衝鋒與守壘的骨干兵器。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 蒂卡爾一方是佩滕盆地低地的城邦聯盟核心。蒂卡爾王國在象形文字裡自稱「第一穆塔爾」（Yax Mutal），國王加冕時採用 kaloomteʼ「大王」的名號，六世紀初由「蒂卡爾夫人」與 Kaloomteʼ Bahlam、Bird Claw 等人共同執政，並把烏夏克吞、亞克斯哈、科潘、奎里瓜等城邦收為附庸或盟友，藉此壟斷佩滕伊察湖周邊的可可、蜂鳥羽毛、翡翠、貝殼與通往內陸高原的物資通道。卡拉克穆爾位於坎佩切低地，控制奧托姆與帕斯翁水系，是加勒比海鹽路與內陸的門戶，同樣以 kaloomteʼ 自號；伯利茲的卡拉科爾地處佩滕盆地東南、扼住通往南部山地的要道，是兩強之間的關鍵第三方。公元562年四月，卡拉克穆爾與卡拉科爾結盟，聯軍夾擊蒂卡爾，構成這場「第一次星際大戰」，亦即第二次蒂卡爾—卡拉科爾戰爭的基本格局。瑪雅城邦沒有常備軍，參戰單位是各城邦派出的王室核心戰士與民兵，聯軍規模隨同盟關係的增減而變動。
countriesEn: Tikal stood at the head of a city-state alliance in the lowland Petén Basin. Its kingdom called itself Yax Mutal, First Mutal, in hieroglyphic inscriptions, and its kings took the title kaloomteʼ, high king. In the early sixth century the city was actually governed by the so-called Lady of Tikal, who ruled together with Kaloomteʼ Bahlam, Bird Claw and others, and it held Uaxactun, Yaxha, Copán and Quiriguá as vassals or allies, monopolising the cacao, hummingbird feathers, jade, shell and upland trade of the Lake Petén Itzá zone. Calakmul, in the Campeche lowlands, controlled the Otom and Pasión drainage and commanded the salt road to the Caribbean, and likewise bore the title kaloomteʼ. Caracol, in Belize, sat on the southeastern rim of the Petén Basin on the road to the southern mountains, and could pick either side. In April 562 CE Calakmul and Caracol allied and struck Tikal from two directions, producing the basic geometry of what is called the first Star War, the second Tikal–Calakmul war. Maya city-states kept no standing armies: each fielded a core of royal warriors plus militia, so the size of any coalition moved with the state of its alliances.
people: 這場戰爭留下的人名主要來自碑銘。蒂卡爾方面，六世紀初實際執政的是被後世稱為「蒂卡爾夫人」的女王，她很可能是國王查克・托克・伊查克二世的女兒，本身並未列入王朝序號，而是與 Kaloomteʼ Bahlam——一位先在蒂卡爾擔任將軍、後以第十九位統治者身分登位的人物——共同統治，其後又與身分不明的 Bird Claw 搭配。公元562年被聯軍擒獲並獻祭的那位蒂卡爾國王，其名字至今未能完整釋讀，我們只知道他是這場戰爭中最關鍵的俘獲對象。聯軍方面，卡拉克穆爾的大王在562年仍以 kaloomteʼ 名號統治，具體身分在不同考訂中尚有爭議；卡拉科爾的國王一般被認為是 Teʼ Kʼab Chaak「持燧石者」，他被認為主持了針對蒂卡爾的攻勢，而今殘蝕嚴重的卡拉科爾二十一號祭壇正是記載這場敗仗的關鍵物證，事實上這段文字的殘損程度正是它長期難以被讀出的原因。背景人物方面，蒂卡爾中斷期間至少有一位國王出走投奔帕蓮克的 Janaabʼ Pakal，與卡拉克穆爾的另一位受害者結盟；而682年樹立蒂卡爾一百二十年來首座有紀年碑的 Jasaw Chan Kʼawiil I，則是這場戰爭的最終贏家在百餘年後的复位者。
peopleEn: The names attached to this war come almost entirely from inscriptions. On the Tikal side, the figure who actually governed in the early sixth century was the woman remembered as the Lady of Tikal, probably a daughter of Chak Tok Ichʼaak II; she was not numbered in the dynasty but co-ruled with Kaloomteʼ Bahlam, a former general of Tikal who later took the throne as the nineteenth ruler in the dynastic sequence, and afterwards with the otherwise unknown Bird Claw. The Tikal ruler seized and sacrificed by the coalition in 562 cannot be read with certainty to this day; we know only that he was the single most important captive of the campaign. On the coalition side, the king of Calakmul still bore the title kaloomteʼ in 562, though his identity remains disputed among readings; the king of Caracol is generally taken to be Teʼ Kʼab Chaak, he of the flint, credited with directing the campaign against Tikal, and it is Caracol's badly eroded Altar 21 that carries the crucial testimony to Tikal's defeat, the very erosion of that text being the reason it resisted reading for so long. In the wider frame, at least one Tikal ruler of the hiatus period took refuge with Janaabʼ Pakal of Palenque, another of Calakmul's victims, while Jasaw Chan Kʼawiil I, who in 682 raised the first dated monument in 120 years, was the restorer who would reverse the verdict a century and a quarter later.
kits: 瑪雅戰士的長柄兵器是這場戰役的骨架。木杆長矛是最普遍的近戰武器，矛頭由削尖的燧石、灰燼石或蛋白石製成，以繩索或樹脂綁在硬木杆上，長度多在兩至三公尺之間，既可作刺擊武器，也可在投擲前握持支撐；卡面所示的「埃及長矛」正是這類長桿突刺矛的最早形態——早王朝時期以銅或青銅矛頭綁於木杆，用於守城與收復失地——在美洲，與之同型的木矛尖早在蒙特韋爾德遺址已可見，瑪雅矛兵沿用的正是這條矛兵技術的源流，兩者同屬「尖頭綁柄」的長矛譜系。除長矛外，瑪雅步兵還攜帶以黑曜石矛頭加木杆的標槍、弓箭、鑲嵌黑曜石刀片的木棒，以及圓形盾牌；防護以棉製胸甲、綁臂護具與獸皮盾為主，精英戰士另加羽飾頭盔、翡翠與貝殼頸飾。攻城沒有投石機一類器械，破壞手段是縱火、拆毀建築與砸毀碑面。補給靠玉米、豆、南瓜、可可與鹽，糧食以獨木舟、馱獸與人力背負，沿石砌堤道和沼澤小徑運送。
kitsEn: Long-hafted weapons formed the skeleton of a Maya army in the field. The wooden spear was the commonest close-combat arm: a chipped flint, chert or obsidian head lashed with cord or resin to a hardwood shaft, usually two to three metres long, usable both for thrusting and as a bracing weapon before a throw. The card's Egyptian spear is simply the earliest form of that same thrusting-pole family, a copper or bronze head bound to a wooden shaft in Egypt's Early Dynastic period, carried to hold ramparts and to recover lost ground, and in Mesoamerica the same peg-and-point logic appears in the wooden points of Monte Verde and was carried on into Classic-period Maya spearmen; the two are branches of one tradition of a chipped point hafted to a shaft. Alongside the spear, Maya infantry carried atlatl throwers with obsidian darts, bows and arrows, macuahuitl wooden clubs inset with obsidian blades, and round shields, defended by cotton-padded chest protectors, forearm bindings and hide shields, while elite warriors added feathered headdresses, jade and shell ornaments. There were no siege engines: demolition meant fire, tearing down buildings and smashing the faces of monuments. Supply ran on maize, beans, squash, cacao and salt, moved by canoe, by pack animals and on human backs along the raised causeways and swamp trails.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術骨架是「聯盟外交加正面決戰」。蒂卡爾與卡拉克穆爾各自經營互不重疊的盟邦網絡，把對手的附庸逐個拉過來，聯盟歸屬一旦倒戈，戰局就會整體傾斜；562年決定一切的便是卡拉克穆爾與卡拉科爾的結盟，使蒂卡爾腹背受敵。行軍方面，瑪雅軍隊沒有連續運作的戰役勤務，遠征多在旱季進行，以便穿越佩滕的沼澤與林地，四月已是旱季的尾聲，雨季臨近，糧秣必須隨軍攜帶。戰鬥以步兵核心展開：長矛手與矛盾手列於前列互相試探，標槍手與弓手在側翼與後方覆蓋，敵我一旦短兵相接，勝負常由體力、紀律與地形控制決定。奪城之後並非全城劫掠，勝方通常摧毀碑銘、毀損公共雕塑象徵性展示戰果，並在儀式上處置被俘的國王，蒂卡爾「未被洗劫、卻被折斷權力」的命運正與此有關。撤退與防守則倚賴沼澤地形、五世紀修築的環繞約一百二十平方公里的壕溝與土垣，以及跨越沼澤的堤道作為進退與補給的通道。
tacticsEn: The grammar of the war was alliance diplomacy plus a decisive field engagement. Tikal and Calakmul each maintained networks of mutually hostile client cities, pulling the other's vassals away one at a time; whenever an allegiance flipped, the whole strategic picture tilted, and the moment that decided everything in 562 was Calakmul's alliance with Caracol, which put Tikal between two fronts. Marching was a matter of seasonal timing: Maya armies had no standing logistics, so campaigns were mounted in the dry season to cross the swamps and forest of Petén, and by April the dry season was ending with the rains about to break, so food had to travel with the column. Battle was decided by infantry: spearmen and spear-and-shield troops in front testing each other, atlatl and bowmen covering from the flanks and rear, and once the lines closed, by endurance, discipline and control of the ground. Conquest did not mean sack: victors normally smashed stelae, mutilated public sculpture to display the result, and handled the captured king within the ritual of defeat, which is precisely why Tikal was not sacked yet broken. Withdrawal and defence relied on the swamps, the ditches and earthworks of the fifth century enclosing some 120 square kilometres, and on causeways bridging the wetlands as arteries of advance, retreat and supply.
data: 可查證的數字集中在幾處。時間點由卡拉科爾二十一號祭壇定在公元562年四月，這也是考古學界把中美洲古典期切分為早古典期與晚古典期的分界，蒂卡爾因此進入持續約一百二十年的「蒂卡爾中斷」期：六世紀下半葉不再豎立新碑，公共雕塑遭到系統性毀損。距離上，蒂卡爾在卡拉克穆爾東南約一百公里，在卡拉科爾西北約八十五公里，位於佩滕伊察湖以北約三十公里，距烏夏克吞十九公里；蒂卡爾遺址總面積逾十六平方公里，含約三千座建築，主要建築群約二點五平方公里，國家公園保護面積約五萬七千公頃。人口方面，公元七百年前後核心區約一萬人，周邊約五萬人。蒂卡爾年降雨量約一千九百四十五毫米，全城僅靠十座蓄水池儲水，說明旱季行軍與守城的艱難。五世紀修築的壕溝與土垣環繞約一百二十平方公里；629年蒂卡爾在西南約一百一十公里處另建多斯皮拉斯作據點；682年才重新出現有紀年的紀念碑；695年後卡拉克穆爾再未立過戰勝碑。蒂卡爾王朝碑銘自前292年二十九號碑至869年十一號碑，橫跨一千一百六十一年、三十三位統治者。
dataEn: The hard numbers are few but firm. The moment is fixed by Caracol's Altar 21 to April 562 CE, the date archaeologists use to divide the Mesoamerican Classic into Early and Late Classic and the start of the so-called Tikal hiatus of roughly 120 years, in which no new stelae were raised in the second half of the sixth century and public sculpture was systematically mutilated. In distance: Tikal lay about 100 km southeast of Calakmul, 85 km northwest of Caracol, about 30 km north of Lake Petén Itzá and 19 km from Uaxactun; the site covers more than 16 square kilometres with some 3,000 structures, the monumental core occupying about 2.5 square kilometres, and the national park protects roughly 57,000 hectares. Population around 700 CE is estimated at about 10,000 in the core and 50,000 in the periphery. Tikal receives about 1,945 mm of rain a year and has no water but rainwater caught in ten reservoirs, which says much about campaigning and defending through the dry season. The fifth-century ditch and earthwork system enclosed about 120 square kilometres; in 629 Tikal founded Dos Pilas about 110 km to the southwest as a forward base; dated monuments returned only in 682; and after 695 Calakmul never raised another victory stela. Tikal's dynastic stelae run from Stela 29 in 292 BC to Stela 11 in 869 AD, spanning 1,161 years and 33 rulers.
cause: 戰爭的起因是六世紀初低地霸權與貿易路線之爭。蒂卡爾在特奧蒂瓦坎退潮後坐大，掌控佩滕伊察湖周邊的高地農業區、北向通往尤卡坦的商路，以及南面通往科潘與內陸高原的門戶，壟斷可可、蜂鳥羽毛、翡翠、貝殼與鹽等高價值物資，其附庸與盟友網絡也延伸到位於伯利茲的卡拉科爾一帶。卡拉克穆爾則憑墨西哥灣沿岸的位置，壟斷奧托姆—帕斯翁水系與通往加勒比海的鹽道，並希望把佩滕盆地納入自己的勢力圈。兩強的正面衝突最終在城邦聯盟的層面上爆發：先是第一次戰爭中蒂卡爾受挫，隨著聯盟重新組合，卡拉科爾轉向卡拉克穆爾一方，兩方聯軍的兵力與資源在數十年積累後足以正面吃掉蒂卡爾的附庸體系，562年四月的會戰就是這種結構性優勢的兌現。
causeEn: The war grew out of a struggle over lowland hegemony and trade in the early sixth century. As Teotihuacan receded, Tikal swelled, holding the fertile uplands around Lake Petén Itzá, the commercial road north toward the Yucatán and the gate to Copán and the southern highlands, and levying cacao, hummingbird feathers, jade, shell and salt, with its clients and allies reaching into the Belizean zone around Caracol. Calakmul, positioned on the Gulf coast, monopolised the Otom–Pasión waterway and the salt road to the Caribbean, and wanted the Petén Basin inside its own orbit. The clash came to a head at the level of the alliance system itself: Tikal had already been humbled in the first of the wars, and as alliances were reshuffled Caracol moved to Calakmul's side. After decades of accumulation, the combined manpower and resources of that pair were sufficient to break Tikal's client network outright, and the field engagement of April 562 was the cashing in of a structural advantage.
impact: 這場敗仗的後果遠超一場會戰。蒂卡爾失去的是作為低地霸主約一百二十年的中斷期：六世紀下半葉無碑可立，公共雕塑遭蓄意毀損，國家儀式與君主威信同時停擺；卡拉科爾因勝勢迅速擴張，甚至可能把部分蒂卡爾人口強制遷往伯利茲，卡拉克穆爾則在蒂卡爾沉寂的歲月裡獨佔低地，並把勢力伸進蒂卡爾南方盟友科潘一帶，738年奎里瓜倒戈即是這條擴張線的結果。蒂卡爾中斷期的君主曾出走到帕蓮克投靠 Janaabʼ Pakal，這條外交線說明聯盟並非固定，而是隨勝負翻轉。學術上，562年被定為早古典期與晚古典期的分水嶺，考古分期、城市衰變與王權崩解的研究都以此為錨點；更長期看，蒂卡爾在682年由 Jasaw Chan Kʼawiil I 重立紀念碑、聲稱 kaloomteʼ，695年扭轉戰局使卡拉克穆爾一蹶不振，「第一次星際大戰」的系列才以蒂卡爾反敗為勝收尾。
impactEn: The consequences of the defeat reached far beyond a single battle. Tikal lost a hiatus of roughly 120 years as lowland hegemon: no stelae were raised in the second half of the sixth century, public sculpture was deliberately broken, and the rituals and prestige of kingship stalled. Caracol expanded quickly on the strength of its victory and may have forcibly relocated part of Tikal's population into Belize, while Calakmul enjoyed an unchallenged lowland primacy during Tikal's silence, extending its reach toward Tikal's southern allies, the defection of Quiriguá in 738 being a result of that line of advance. A Tikal ruler of the hiatus fled to Janaabʼ Pakal at Palenque, showing that alliances too were contingent on results. Scholarly, 562 became the watershed between Early and Late Classic, the anchor for every study of urban decline and the collapse of royal authority. In the long run, Tikal's return under Jasaw Chan Kʼawiil I, a dated monument in 682 and the claim to the title kaloomteʼ, and the reversal of 695, which left Calakmul never to recover, closed the first Star War cycle with Tikal turning defeat into victory.
result: 結果是蒂卡爾的全面崩解與權力真空。公元562年四月，蒂卡爾在卡拉科爾與卡拉克穆爾的聯合攻勢下遭到決定性敗北，國王被俘並在儀式上被獻祭，城市沒有遭到全面劫掠，卻在制度上被折斷：蒂卡爾不再豎碑，公共雕刻被砸毀，作為低地霸主的政治與經濟網絡分崩離析，隨之而來的便是被後世稱為「蒂卡爾中斷」的長達約一百二十年的沉寂期，直到682年才重新出現有紀年的紀念碑。聯盟方坐收漁利，卡拉科爾在勝後迅速壯大並吸收蒂卡爾的人口與資源，卡拉克穆爾在蒂卡爾沉寂的半個多世紀裡成為低地最有力的強權，並靠著對多斯皮拉斯等據點的經營把戰線推向蒂卡爾，直到七世紀末才被蒂卡爾方面的反攻徹底壓制。這場戰爭從此成為中美洲考古與歷史書寫中最著名的一次城邦崩解案例，也是「星際大戰」系列戰事的第一場。
resultEn: The outcome was Tikal's total collapse and a vacuum of power. In April 562 CE Tikal suffered a decisive defeat under the joint attack of Caracol and Calakmul; its king was taken and sacrificed in the ritual of defeat, the city itself was not comprehensively looted, yet institutionally it was broken: stelae ceased, public sculpture was smashed, and the political and economic network that had made Tikal hegemon came apart, bringing on the long silence known as the Tikal hiatus, which lasted until a dated monument reappeared in 682. The victors took the spoils: Caracol grew fast and absorbed Tikal's people and resources, while Calakmul became the strongest power in the lowlands for the better part of the following century, pushing the war front toward Tikal through holdings such as Dos Pilas, until the Tikal counteroffensive in the later seventh century crushed it for good. The episode remains the most famous case of civic collapse in Mesoamerican history and the opening engagement of the Star War sequence.
